resources.string: Overlingo %1$s · text recognition: Google ML Kit · translation: Google, DeepL, Microsoft or on the phone (ML Kit) · voice: the phone\'s text-to-speech or Microsoft voices
Point at text and take a photo
Overlingo needs the camera to photograph text. You can also pick a photo from the gallery.
This screen is not available on your phone
Tap the blocks to read - in the order you tap them
Free keys end with \":fx\" and use the free DeepL server automatically.
Invalid API key - check it in Settings
No API key - enter it in Settings
No internet connection - translation requires internet
Too many requests or quota exceeded - try again later
The primary service failed - Google was used instead
If the selected service fails, translate with Google
Region is needed only for regional Azure resources (e.g. westeurope); leave empty for global ones.
Get closer, hold the phone straight and make sure there is enough light. Only Latin-script text is recognized for now.
Type or paste text to translate
The voice for this language is not downloaded yet. Download it from the phone\'s text-to-speech settings - it then works offline.
Microsoft voice failed - reading with the phone voice
No internet - reading with the phone voice
Microsoft has no voice for this language - reading with the phone voice
The voice engine is still starting - try again in a second
The phone\'s voice engine does not support this language. You can switch the engine (e.g. to Google Speech Services) in the text-to-speech settings.
Uses the phone\'s built-in text-to-speech. Voices for each language are downloaded once from the phone\'s settings.
Free, no key - the same voices as in the desktop version. The voice is picked by the translation language. Without internet the phone voice reads instead.
Google ML Kit, built into the app and working offline. Reads Latin-script text (English, German, French, Spanish, Italian…). Cyrillic, Greek and Arabic are not recognized yet.

Translates on the phone itself with Google ML Kit. The first time for each language a model of about 30 MB is downloaded (internet needed once), after that it works offline. The quality is lower than the online services.
Dark text on a white background
At 100% the text fills the window; larger text extends the window downwards. Applies to saved and shared photos too.
About 30 MB, only the first time - after that it works offline.
No internet - translated on the phone
This language is not available for offline translation
The offline translation model is not downloaded
The translation model could not be downloaded - internet is needed the first time
The photo could not be saved
Without access to storage the photo can\'t be saved
It disappears from the photo, isn\'t read aloud and isn\'t included when you save or share. Tap the frame to show it again.
